title: Privileged User Onboarding Intake Framework (RBAC / SSO / SCIM)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Enterprise customers repeatedly submit ad-hoc requests for privileged admin access, SSO/SAML integrations, and SCIM provisioning changes. Requests arrive via email, support tickets, and sales notes which causes rework, inconsistent risk assessments, and slow time-to-onboard. Goal: create a lightweight, standardized intake + triage framework that maps incoming requests to (1) a risk score, (2) required artifacts and approvers, and (3) an operational SLA and routing path (self-serve, solutions engineering, or security review). This ticket defines the PM scope: form fields, scoring rules, owner responsibilities, console-facing hints, and metrics to evaluate success.
acceptance_criteria: Published intake form template (Notion + internal Support form) covering RBAC, SSO, SCIM, org policies and required artifacts
Triage rubric documented with scoring weights for security risk, user count, data sensitivity, and regulatory zone
Routing matrix implemented (auto-route to Solutions Eng, Security Review, Dedicated sales) and validated with 3 sample requests
SLA targets defined: initial ack within 24h, prep checklist within 3 business days, full onboarding timeline estimate within 10 business days for P1 requests
Console guidance microcopy & a 'Request access' CTA prototype for next design sprint
Telemetry defined: time-to-first-response, time-to-complete-onboarding, % requests escalated to Security, and customer satisfaction for onboards
Security review gate and checklist added to the intake flow and approved by Security leadership

proposed_intake_fields: Requested feature: RBAC role change | New SSO/SAML IdP | SCIM provisioning | Org policy override
List of attributes for SCIM provisioning (CSV or JSON schema)
SSO metadata (IdP metadata XML or metadata URL)
Required compliance standards (SOC2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, etc.)
Attachments: diagrams, support tickets, contract clauses
triage_rubric: Security sensitivity (0-40): based on data classification and whether admin-level tokens or KMS access required
User impact (0-25): number of users affected and role scope (single user vs. org-wide role)
Regulatory/contract constraint (0-20): presence of regulated data or explicit contractual SLAs
Operational complexity (0-15): SCIM mapping complexity, custom role rules, or need for private deployment changes
routing_matrix: Score 0-29 => Self-serve guidance + docs link, SLA: auto-response with link within 24h
Score 30-59 => Solutions Engineering handle (manual onboarding); SLA: acknowledgement 24h, initial plan 3 business days
Score 60-100 => Security & Enterprise Eng review required; schedule kickoff within 48h and full plan within 10 business days
ui_microcopy_proposals: Small helper: 'Provide examples: IdP metadata, SCIM sample, and reason for access'
Inline tip next to SCIM: 'If you need SCIM provisioning, include a minimal schema (id, userName, emails) to speed mapping'
Post-submission: 'Your request has been received. We'll respond within 24 hours with next steps.'
